scope: candidate11 windowed/live: all 16 completed combinations, six targets each, plus eight paired WebView originals
method: Direct visual inspection through view_image of each listed original PNG. Completion JSON was used only to authorize reading completed groups; DOM/geometry/results were not used as a substitute for pixel inspection. No UI, test, build, or image transformation was run.
classificationDefinition: targetComplete means the selected target's rendered semantic content and diagram geometry are visible in this captured viewport. partial means some target content/geometry is outside an editor or inner-preview clipping boundary. The SAMPLE marker and neighbouring targets are excluded from target completeness; marker visibility is separately described. These are screenshot visibility classifications, not functional pass/fail or scroll-reachability assertions.
findings: All 96 target frames were actually viewed; 76 target contents were complete in the captured viewport and 20 partial. No blank target preview or missing-glyph boxes were observed in these frames.

Root formula and matrix content were fully visible in all 16 combinations. Chinese text, mathematical fractions/roots/integrals, matrix parentheses and entries remained legible; 100% formula glyphs are small but distinguishable.

Flow content was partial at 150% narrow and 200% wide/narrow in both themes: 150% narrow completion node falls below editor edge; 200% wide completion label remains visible but lower outline is clipped; 200% narrow decision/completion extend below editor viewport.
Sequence content was partial only at 200% narrow in both themes: actor/service and forward request arrow are visible, but return arrow and lower lifelines are below the viewport.

Pie content was partial in 12 frames: all except 100% wide and 125% wide in each theme. At 100% narrow, 125% narrow and 150% wide, lower circle is clipped while legends are complete. At 150% narrow legend percentages/right tails are also clipped; 200% wide has clipped legend endings; 200% narrow legends are outside the captured viewport. Visible scrollbars were recorded but not operated.

Footnote references, all three return links and complete definition were visible in all 16 target frames. Narrow 150/200% definitions wrap; at 200% narrow the SAMPLE marker is above the visible viewport, while reference/definition content is fully visible.

Dark theme uses light text and pale-blue diagram/link accents against a dark background; light theme uses dark text and green accents. Selected SAMPLE markers remain distinguishable where shown. Static selection highlighting is not proof of keyboard focus.
Status/header UI scales with zoom. At 200% narrow the line-count status is ellipsized, while saved-state text remains visible; this is not a text-data-loss finding.
All eight actual paired WebView inspections agreed with the corresponding X11 target appearance and clipping boundaries. Black outside the X11 application rectangle is desktop background.
uncovered: No scroll, End/Home, pointer hit, keyboard focus, navigation or editing action was performed by this pixel reviewer.

Partial viewport content does not prove inability to reach that content, nor absence or data loss. Supplemental 200% narrow reachability tests, if separately completed, must not be generalized to every matrix zoom/width.
Only eight WebView counterparts were inspected; the remaining 88 WebView counterparts were not visually reviewed here.
This review does not evaluate the concurrent all-disabled/recovery steps, overall native completion, dynamic redraw stability, or noncaptured states.
reviewStatus: all scoped original images visually inspected; viewport completeness classified; no overall native PASS claim
